nodes.text:
They call me that because I came back up. It's meant kindly and it isn't.

I sell taking-words. I learned them from something that was using them on me.

choices.label: You came back up from where?

nodes.text:
The trench. Three days. I don't know how — I've stopped asking, because the only answer that fits is one I'd rather not have.

What I brought back was the grammar. Down there, taking isn't cruelty. It's just how anything moves from one thing to another. I find that more frightening than teeth.
